clips.title: The story
paras: Near Agamand Mills, Devlin Agamand’s bones carry a bitter legacy. The younger son of the wealthy family that owned the mills, he roamed the road by his ruined home as a mindless Scourge thrall. A traveler struck him down and brought his remains to a survivor in Brill, who sought vengeance.

Devlin Agamand lived in the shadow of his elder brother Thurman. Thurman was gentle and tall, while Devlin was frail and sharp-tongued. When the Plague of Undeath swept through northern Tirisfal Glades, the Agamand family failed to protect its lands and laborers. Devlin was among the first to fall. The Scourge raised him as a ravenous ghoul, and his mad chattering haunted the roadside leading to Agamand Mills.

Coleman Farthing lives in Brill and holds a deep grudge against the Agamand bloodline. He blames the family for failing his own when the plague came. Farthing sent travelers to lay Devlin to rest and gather his remains. He wanted Devlin’s bones on his mantle, to savor how his former masters had been reduced to dust and shattered fragments beneath his heel.
